apply_layer_preset.summary: Explicitly apply one layer preset to a Stackup.
apply_layer_preset.text:
Explicitly apply one layer preset to a Stackup.

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.layer_preset_apply`.

Arguments:

- `pdk_id` (required): Canonical display id (either spelling resolves).
- `name` (required): Built-in or user preset name.
- `revision`: Revision pin; the newest registered revision when omitted.
- `engine_root`: Explicit store root; resolved when omitted.

Returns:

Full preset record with the complete layers map, renderLayers, flip, and active.

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_command for a missing pdk_id or name. PdkError: unknown_pdk for a missing store/id/revision. LayerServingError: unknown_stackup for an unmapped PDK, unknown_preset for a missing preset, invalid_preset for a stale user preset.

apply_mutations.summary: Apply a batch atomically under one new revision (I31).
apply_mutations.text:
Apply a batch atomically under one new revision (I31).

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.apply_mutations`.

Every mutation is validated before anything lands: any
failure names its document and leaves the revision, the
files, and the log untouched. Only a fully valid batch at
the live head advances once and appends a single
mutations_applied event.

Arguments:

- `mutations` (required): Non-empty list of {op, path, content?} mappings; op is write (needs text content) or delete (takes none).
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with revision transition, new head, actor, joined diff summary, rewind handle, the single appended event, per-mutation results, cursor, and request id.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; invalid_command for a malformed batch (names the document when one is addressable); invalid_path or path_escape for a bad path; unknown_document for a delete of a missing document; revision_conflict for a stale head; invalid_ledger when a durable write fails (best effort rollback already attempted).

Caution: All-or-nothing means one revision for the whole batch — a half-landed batch is a bug, never a state.

attach_component.text:
Attach one new component (refuses overwrites).

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.attach_component`.

Like set_component, but a component already living on the
entity fails instead of overwriting — attach means add.

A resubmitted envelope returns its stored response without
advancing.

Arguments:

- `entity` (required): Entity id holding the component.
- `component` (required): Component name to attach.
- `data` (required): JSON payload to store.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with entity, component, canonical address, storage path, revision transition, new head, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the component_changed event, cursor, and request id.

Raises:

ProjectError: component_exists when the component already lives on the entity; otherwise like set_component.

Caution: Every accepted attach advances the revision — a second writer at the old head fails instead of merging.

components_of.summary: List the component names one entity carries.
components_of.text:
List the component names one entity carries.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.components_of`.

Arguments:

- `entity` (required): Entity id to inspect (backfilled ids serve their projected doc component).

Returns:

Mapping with project id, head revision, entity, storage path, and sorted component names.

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_entity for a malformed id; unknown_entity for a missing entity; invalid_document for a corrupt entity record.

connect_endpoint.summary: Point one wire endpoint at a new terminus: gate, run, log.
connect_endpoint.text:
Point one wire endpoint at a new terminus: gate, run, log.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.connect_endpoint`.

Geometry never moves — only the ref changes — and a
no-change call returns the head unadvanced with an empty
event list instead of logging a phantom revision.

Arguments:

- `wire_id` (required): Wire entity to rewire.
- `end` (required): "a" or "b" selecting the endpoint.
- `ref` (required): Pin/port/junction/net entity ID, or null to dangle the endpoint.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with the connect receipt, revision transition, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the appended event, cursor, and request id — or the unadvanced noop mapping when the ref is already set.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; revision_conflict for a stale head; unknown_wire for a missing wire; invalid_endpoint for a bad selector; unknown_ref for a missing entity; invalid_ref for a wire/self ref; unsupported_operation without the ENGINE-ECS entity store.

create_entity.summary: Create one entity with an engine-minted id.
create_entity.text:
Create one entity with an engine-minted id.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.create_entity`.

The id is minted, never supplied: there is no id argument,
so callers cannot collide with, guess, or squat on engine
identity. The record persists as entities/<id>.json through
the same admission machinery as write_doc (idempotent
request ids, revision gate, one new revision, one event,
atomic persist, rewind snapshots).

A resubmitted envelope returns its stored response without
advancing.

Arguments:

- `kind`: Kind label carried beside the components.
- `components`: Optional initial component mapping.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with the minted entity, kind, storage path, revision transition, new head, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the entity_created event, cursor, request id, and initial component names.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; invalid_kind, invalid_component, or invalid_data for malformed parts; revision_conflict for a stale head; invalid_ledger when the durable write fails.

Caution: Every accepted create advances the revision — a second writer at the old head fails instead of merging.

create_project.summary: Create one managed project at revision p12.
create_project.text:
Create one managed project at revision p12.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.create_project`.

The new ledger starts clean (no events); the response still
carries the approval-UI fields with a None prior revision.
Idempotent replays return the stored response instead of
failing as duplicates.

Arguments:

- `new_project_id` (required): Slug for the project to create.

Returns:

Creation mapping with the new project id, p12 head, actor, diff summary, revision transition, rewind handle, empty events, and request id.

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_command without an engine root; invalid_project for a non-slug id; project_exists for a duplicate; request_conflict for a reused id with new text; invalid_ledger when the project dir cannot be written.

Caution: Creating the bound project itself is a duplicate once its dir exists — create-then-list, never assume.

delete_doc.text:

Caution: Deleting advances the revision like any mutation — stale writers fail instead of merging.

delete_entity.text:

get_capabilities.summary: Report per-solver availability, store state, and the provision menu.
get_capabilities.text:
Report per-solver availability, store state, and the provision menu.

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.capabilities`.

The engine side of the Vivado-style setup surface: every
cataloged operation with readiness (ready when some
registered tool resolves, or when the Engine serves the
operation directly; blocked with reason + missing items
+ remedy when no tool resolves; unsupported when no
solver is registered), each tool's availability from its
own detection probe plus its adapter capabilities(),
PDK/deck install state from the store, BYOC-gated cloud
rows, and the checkbox provision catalogue with live
install state.

Arguments:

- `target`: Target passed to each adapter's capabilities().
- `engine_root`: Explicit store root; ROCKETEDA_HOME resolution when omitted.

Returns:

Capability mapping with operations, store, pdks, decks, cloud, and catalogue sections.

Raises:

SetupError: unknown_solver when a registered (operation, tool) has no detection spec — the report fails instead of misreporting a solver it cannot probe.

Caution: Read-only: never creates the store skeleton and never attempts network — cloud rows report gated with key_state missing until CLOUD-AUTH supplies keys plus an explicit opt-in (F12/I32 BYOC).

get_check_results.text:

get_component.summary: Read one entity component payload at the current head.
get_component.text:
Read one entity component payload at the current head.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.get_component`.

Entities project over plain documents: the record lives at
entities/<entity>.json and reads through the same bytes
read_doc serves. Backfilled doc entities serve their
projected doc component here, so every world-snapshot
entry stays addressable.

Arguments:

- `entity` (required): Entity id holding the component.
- `component` (required): Component name to read.

Returns:

Mapping with project id, head revision, entity, component, canonical address, storage path, and the component data.

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_entity or invalid_component for malformed parts; unknown_entity for a missing entity; unknown_component for a missing component; invalid_document for a corrupt entity record.

get_events_since.summary: Read retained events after a cursor, oldest first.
get_events_since.text:
Read retained events after a cursor, oldest first.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.events_since`.

Arguments:

- `cursor`: Only events with a higher seq are returned.
- `require_contiguous_from`: Assert the reader holds contiguous history from this seq; fails when the history aged out of retention or runs ahead of the live cursor.

Returns:

Retained events after the cursor, seq-ordered.

Raises:

ProjectError: resync_required when the contiguity demand cannot be met — the reader must re-read the snapshot plus the full retained log and reset its cursor.

Caution: The log is retention-bounded, not infinite — a reader gone longer than the bound must resync, never assume the gap is empty.

get_job_status.text:
Read one run's state, verdict, and evidence links.

Run state mapping with state, verdict, and log links.

ExecutionError: unknown_run for an unregistered id.

get_layer_rows.summary: Render viewer rows for one PDK's stackup.
get_layer_rows.text:
Render viewer rows for one PDK's stackup.

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.layer_rows`.

Row visibility defaults to the PDK flags; an explicit
preset applies first, then per-layer overrides, then the
active layer.

Arguments:

- `pdk_id` (required): Canonical display id (either spelling resolves).
- `preset`: Built-in or user preset to apply; PDK defaults when omitted.
- `overrides`: Sparse {layer name: visible} wins over the preset map.
- `active`: Active layer override; the preset active when omitted.
- `revision`: Revision pin; the newest registered revision when omitted.
- `engine_root`: Explicit store root; resolved when omitted.

Returns:

Page with stackup_ref, preset, flip, active, and file-order rows.

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_command for a missing pdk_id. PdkError: unknown_pdk for a missing store/id/revision. LayerServingError: unknown_stackup for an unmapped PDK, unknown_preset for a missing preset, invalid_preset for a stale user preset, invalid_visibility for bad overrides/active.

get_layer_stackup.summary: Serve one PDK's read-only layer stackup.
get_layer_stackup.text:
Serve one PDK's read-only layer stackup.

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.layer_stackup`.

The viewer/3D authority: ordered layers, metal/tech
grouping, enabled set, colors, and Z heights parsed from
the registered PDK's KLayout tech files (hash-verified
through the PDK store).

Arguments:

- `pdk_id` (required): Canonical display id (either spelling resolves).
- `revision`: Revision pin; the newest registered revision when omitted.
- `engine_root`: Explicit store root; resolved when omitted.

Returns:

Stackup record with layers, enabled set, groups, and Z completeness.

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_command for a missing pdk_id. PdkError: unknown_pdk for a missing store/id/revision or .lyp deck, pdk_drift for a tampered file. LayerServingError: unknown_stackup for a PDK with no stackup mapping.

get_logs.summary: Search and page one run's captured native log.
get_logs.text:
Search and page one run's captured native log.

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.run_logs`.

Arguments:

- `run_id`: Run whose log to read.
- `query`: Case-insensitive substring filter; all lines when omitted.
- `offset`: First matching line to return (0-based).
- `limit`: Maximum lines per page (capped server-side).

Returns:

Page mapping with numbered lines, totals, and a more flag.

Raises:

ExecutionError: unknown_run for an unregistered id. ProjectError: invalid_command for a non-int offset or limit.

get_project_snapshot.summary: Read the ledger head: project, revision, and event cursor.
get_project_snapshot.text:
Read the ledger head: project, revision, and event cursor.

Snapshot mapping with project_id, current_revision, and event_cursor.

Read the python_execute console view.

- _(none)_

get_resolved_config.summary: Bundle the resolved config for one session/run fetch.
get_resolved_config.text:
Bundle the resolved config for one session/run fetch.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.resolved_config`.

All five kinds in one call — clients render from this
snapshot instead of per-event round-trips. Absent files
resolve to defaults; library refs stay unresolved here
(callers resolve lib.tables refs against their own roots).

Arguments:

- `session_id`: Client session this snapshot serves.
- `run_id`: Run this snapshot was resolved for, if any.

Returns:

Snapshot mapping with project id, head revision, session/run ids, per-kind versions, all five settings mappings, and library refs.

Raises:

ProjectError: future_format when any stored file is newer than the head; missing_migration when no link covers a stored version; invalid_document for stored settings that do not parse.

get_world_snapshot.summary: Bundle the miniplex-shaped world snapshot for mirrors.
get_world_snapshot.text:
Bundle the miniplex-shaped world snapshot for mirrors.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.world_snapshot`.

A pure read: snapshotting never writes and never advances
the revision, so backfill cannot break any revision. Each
entry maps one-to-one onto a miniplex entity (id plus its
components), so mirrors load it directly.

Arguments:

- `include_backfill`: Project current plain docs as read-only virtual entities alongside engine entities; engine entities only when False.

Returns:

Snapshot mapping with project id, head revision, and entities sorted by id (each with id, kind, and components).

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_command for a non-bool flag; invalid_document for a corrupt entity record.

list_projects.text:

list_survivors.summary: Report crash survivors without executing anything (boot report).
list_survivors.text:
Report crash survivors without executing anything (boot report).

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.boot_report`.

Survivors are ledger admissions without a run event —
typically a kill between admit and drain. Each carries its
taxonomy kind (retryable, ambiguous, poison), quarantine
state, and per-run Resume/Discard actions.

Arguments:

- _(none)_

Returns:

Report with the session-ended message, the unfinished count, survivors in admit order, quarantined run ids, and unresolved entries.

Caution: Report-only by construction: nothing executes here — every replay surface needs an explicit resume decision (resume_run, discard_run, resume_all_retryable).

materialize_nets.summary: Extract connectivity, upsert Net entities: gate, run, log.
materialize_nets.text:
Extract connectivity, upsert Net entities: gate, run, log.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.materialize_nets`.

Extraction always rebuilds from the stored wires; Nets
keyed by canonical name are created or refreshed, vanished
names pruned, all in one revision. An unchanged world
returns the head unadvanced with an empty event list.

Arguments:

- `pins` (required): Caller pin records [{entity, instance, pin, xy}].
- `labels`: Caller label records [{name, xy}].
- `ports`: Caller port records [{name, direction}].
- `cell`: Top cell name.
- `named_refs`: {entity ID: net name} for port-style refs.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with the materialize receipt (nets, created/updated/pruned, unresolved), revision transition, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the appended event, cursor, and request id — or the unadvanced noop mapping when every Net matches.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; revision_conflict for a stale head; invalid_pin / invalid_label / invalid_port / invalid_cell / invalid_ref for malformed inputs; extraction_failed when extraction refuses the world; unsupported_operation without the ENGINE-ECS entity store.

move_wire.text:
Translate one wire: gate, transact, advance, log.

unadvanced with an empty event list.

Arguments:

- `wire_id` (required): Wire entity to move.
- `dx` (required): Integer x translation.
- `dy` (required): Integer y translation.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with the move receipt, revision transition, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the appended event, cursor, and request id — or the unadvanced noop mapping for a zero move.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; revision_conflict for a stale head; unknown_wire for a missing wire; invalid_geometry for non-integer deltas; unsupported_operation without the ENGINE-ECS entity store.

place_cell.summary: Declared operation `place_cell`; no handler wired yet.

place_wire.text:
Place one wire: gate, transact, advance, log.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.place_wire`.

advancing; a new envelope gates its expected_revision, and

Arguments:

- `layer` (required): Layer name for every segment.
- `endpoints` (required): [a, b] endpoint mappings; each ref is a pin/port/junction/net entity ID or null when dangling.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with the wire receipt, revision transition, new head, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the appended event, cursor, and request id.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; revision_conflict for a stale head; unknown_ref for a ref naming no entity; invalid_ref for a wire ref; invalid_wire for a malformed wire; unsupported_operation without the ENGINE-ECS entity store.

Caution: Every accepted placement advances the revision — a second writer at the old head fails instead of merging.

rewind.summary: Restore managed bytes to a prior revision under a new head.
rewind.text:
Restore managed bytes to a prior revision under a new head.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.rewind`.

The target snapshot replaces every managed document
byte-identically; runs, the ledger, and the snapshots
themselves are left alone. History stays append-only: the
restore advances from the live head and appends a single
`project_rewound` event recording the target. Linked caller
trees are never written — files outside `.rocket/` are
listed in the response as left untouched.

Arguments:

- `target_revision` (required): Snapshot revision to restore.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with revision transition, target revision, new head, actor, diff summary, external-file report, rewind handle, the appended event, cursor, and request id.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; invalid_command for a missing target or a target that equals the live head; unknown_revision for a revision with no snapshot; revision_conflict for a stale head; invalid_ledger when the durable restore fails (best-effort rollback already attempted).

Caution: Rewinding advances — the new head is not the target id, and stale writers fail instead of merging. Caller files outside `.rocket/` are reported, never touched.

run_connectivity.summary: Shared-graph connectivity checks plus netlist emission.
run_connectivity.text:
Shared-graph connectivity checks plus netlist emission.

Tools: `connectgraph` (default) — `deck.tool` selects; a missing tool falls back to the default, an unknown tool fails `unsupported_operation` before anything runs.

Handlers: `rocket_engine.adapters.connectivity.ConnectivityAdapter`.

#### Tool `connectgraph`

Shared-graph connectivity checks plus netlist emission.

Serves run_connectivity and run_erc with deck.tool
`connectgraph` (the only tool). Extraction, naming, and emission
all run in-process; there is no tool to resolve and no timeout.

Arguments:

- `schematic` (required): Schematic record (see workflows.connectgraph for the shape).
- `languages`: Netlist languages for run_connectivity (default all of spice, verilog, vhdl).
- `run_key`: Explicit extraction-cache key; uncached when omitted.
- `deck`: Optional mapping; deck.tool must be connectgraph here.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read; defaults to the command's own expected_revision entry.
- `request`: Explicit run knobs (xschem live-var equivalents), frozen into the run snapshot. Unknown fields are rejected.

Returns:

{total, violations[]} plus measurements with netlists, the net table, counts, and skipped instances.

Raises:

(preflight) AdapterError: unsupported_operation for another operation or deck tool, invalid_command for a missing schematic or an unknown language.

(execute) AdapterError: invalid_command for a malformed schematic, plus the preflight codes (execute re-checks first).

(parse) AdapterError: runner_unavailable when the output has no findings list.

Caution: run_erc fails on unconnected pins while run_connectivity only warns — same findings, different policy; read the verdict, never the exit path.

run_drc.summary: run_drc via Magic: batch DRC over .mag cells, lambda-unit boxes.
run_drc.text:
run_drc via Magic: batch DRC over .mag cells, lambda-unit boxes.

Tools: `magic` (default), `klayout` — `deck.tool` selects; a missing tool falls back to the default, an unknown tool fails `unsupported_operation` before anything runs.

Handlers: `rocket_engine.adapters.drc.MagicDrcAdapter`, `rocket_engine.adapters.drc_kl.KlayoutDrcAdapter`.

#### Tool `magic`

run_drc via Magic: batch DRC over .mag cells, lambda-unit boxes.

Serves the run_drc operation with deck.tool `magic` (the
operation default). Tcl over stdin against a loaded cell; the
result is {total, violations[]} with rule/message plus
lambda-unit bbox areas.

Arguments:

- `cell` (required): Cell name loaded inside magic.
- `cell_file` (required): Path to the .mag cell file.
- `tech`: Magic tech name (default scmos).
- `deck`: Optional mapping; deck.tool selects the solver (magic here, klayout for the KLayout path).
- `workdir`: Run directory (default ".").
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read; defaults to the command's own expected_revision entry.
- `request`: Explicit run knobs (xschem live-var equivalents), frozen into the run snapshot. Unknown fields are rejected.

Returns:

{total, violations[]} with rule plus lambda-unit bbox areas.

Raises:

(preflight) AdapterError: unsupported_operation for another operation, missing_dependency for a missing magic binary or unloadable tech, invalid_reference for a missing cell file.

(execute) AdapterError: missing_dependency when the tech fails to load mid-run, runner_unavailable when magic output carries no DRC total line, plus the preflight codes (execute re-checks first).

(parse) AdapterError: runner_unavailable when the output has no DRC total line.

Caution: Magic exits 0 even for broken cells and unknown techs — the verdict always comes from parsed output, never the exit code. Timeout is fixed at 120 s.

#### Tool `klayout`

run_drc via KLayout: synthetic checks or foundry .lydrc decks.

Serves the run_drc operation with deck.tool `klayout`. Two
modes: synthetic width/space checks over one layer from
`rules`, or a foundry .lydrc deck over `gds_file` with
violations parsed from the report database. Locations are
metric bbox_um.

Arguments:

- `gds_file` (required): GDS layout under check.
- `rules`: Synthetic check {layer [l, d], width_um, space_um, name?} — one check form is required (rules or a deck file).
- `deck_file`: Foundry .lydrc deck path (deck mode).
- `deck`: Optional mapping; deck.tool selects the solver (klayout here), deck.path/deck_file/file names the deck in deck mode.
- `workdir`: Run directory (default ".").
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read; defaults to the command's own expected_revision entry.
- `request`: Explicit run knobs (xschem live-var equivalents), frozen into the run snapshot. Unknown fields are rejected.

Returns:

{total, violations[]} with rule, message, and metric bbox_um where the deck reports geometry.

Raises:

(preflight) AdapterError: unsupported_operation for another operation, missing_dependency for a missing klayout binary, invalid_reference for a missing GDS or deck file, invalid_command for a malformed rules mapping.

(execute) AdapterError: invalid_reference for a missing workdir, runner_unavailable when klayout produces no report, plus the preflight codes (execute re-checks first).

(parse) AdapterError: runner_unavailable when the deck run has no report, the report is not valid XML, or the synthetic output has no TOTAL line.

Caution: KLayout exits 0 regardless — the verdict always comes from parsed output, never the exit code.

run_extraction.summary: run_extraction via Magic: .mag cells to .ext/.spice netlists.
run_extraction.text:
run_extraction via Magic: .mag cells to .ext/.spice netlists.

Tools: `magic` (default) — `deck.tool` selects; a missing tool falls back to the default, an unknown tool fails `unsupported_operation` before anything runs.

Handlers: `rocket_engine.adapters.extract_magic.MagicExtractAdapter`.

#### Tool `magic`

run_extraction via Magic: .mag cells to .ext/.spice netlists.

Serves the run_extraction operation with deck.tool `magic` (the
only tool). Loads the cell, extracts all, and converts with
ext2spice; the result carries the netlist artifact paths plus
device counts.

Arguments:

- `cell` (required): Cell name loaded and extracted.
- `cell_file` (required): Path to the .mag cell file.
- `tech` (required): Magic tech name — one tech form is required (tech, tech_file, or deck.path/tech_file/file).
- `tech_file`: Magic tech file path (a hash-checked store deck by the caller).
- `deck`: Optional mapping naming the tech file (deck.path/tech_file/file).
- `workdir`: Run directory (default ".").
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read; defaults to the command's own expected_revision entry.
- `request`: Explicit run knobs (xschem live-var equivalents), frozen into the run snapshot. Unknown fields are rejected.

Returns:

Result with cell, artifact paths, device_count, devices, and no violations.

Raises:

(preflight) AdapterError: unsupported_operation for another operation, invalid_command for a missing cell, a Tcl-unsafe cell name, or no tech form, missing_dependency for a missing magic binary or unloadable tech, invalid_reference for a missing cell or tech file.

(execute) AdapterError: invalid_reference for a missing workdir, missing_dependency when the tech fails to load mid-run, runner_unavailable when the output has no ext2spice marker or no .ext/.spice pair, plus the preflight codes (execute re-checks first).

(parse) AdapterError: runner_unavailable when the output has no ext2spice marker, no spice text, or no subckt block.

Caution: Magic exits 0 even for broken cells — the verdict always comes from parsed output, never the exit code.

run_hdl_test via Icarus: compile plus timed Verilog sim.

Serves the run_hdl_test operation with deck.tool `icarus` (the
only tool). Compiles the sources with iverilog, runs the sim
under vvp with a timeout, and parses compile diagnostics plus

Arguments:

- `defines`: Verilog `define list, optional =value each.

- `tool_dir`: Directory holding iverilog/vvp; PATH otherwise.
- `deck`: Optional mapping; deck.tool must be icarus here.

- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read; defaults to the command's own expected_revision entry.

{total, violations[]} with file/line locations and sim_time where the sim reports it.

run_job.summary: Execute admitted requests by id: deferred singles, fetch, batches.
run_job.text:
Execute admitted requests by id: deferred singles, fetch, batches.

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.run` (phase 2 executes an admitted request; submit admits first).

Arguments:

- `run_id`: Admitted run to execute or fetch.
- `request_id`: Envelope id admitted by an earlier submit (resolves to its run when run_id is absent).
- `run_ids`: Batch form — admitted runs to pump oldest listed first.

Returns:

Completion mapping with run_id, state, verdict, and operation for a single id (stored, never re-executed, when the run already finished); batch mapping with run_ids, completions, and refused for the batch form (every listed id lands in exactly one of the two lists).

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_command when the arguments lack a run id or the batch list is malformed, unknown_request for an id never admitted, unsupported_operation when the admitted operation has no registered solver.

run_lvs.summary: run_lvs via Netgen: layout vs schematic, TOP-level compare.
run_lvs.text:
run_lvs via Netgen: layout vs schematic, TOP-level compare.

Tools: `netgen` (default) — `deck.tool` selects; a missing tool falls back to the default, an unknown tool fails `unsupported_operation` before anything runs.

Handlers: `rocket_engine.adapters.lvs_netgen.NetgenLvsAdapter`.

#### Tool `netgen`

run_lvs via Netgen: layout vs schematic, TOP-level compare.

Serves the run_lvs operation with deck.tool `netgen` (the only
tool). Both netlists flatten to top level first (a library file
needs `cell` to select its block), then the one-shot batch LVS
runs; the result is {match, total, violations[]} with net and
device mismatches.

Arguments:

- `layout_spice` (required): Layout netlist path.
- `schematic_spice` (required): Schematic netlist path.
- `setup_file` (required): Netgen setup path — one setup form is required (setup_file or deck.path/setup_file/setup/ file).
- `deck`: Optional mapping naming the setup file (see above).
- `cell`: .subckt block to select from library netlists.
- `workdir`: Run directory (default ".").
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read; defaults to the command's own expected_revision entry.
- `request`: Explicit run knobs (xschem live-var equivalents), frozen into the run snapshot. Unknown fields are rejected.

Returns:

{match, total, violations[]} with lvs_net_mismatch and lvs_device_mismatch rules.

Raises:

(preflight) AdapterError: unsupported_operation for another operation, missing_dependency for a missing netgen or a banner-rejected impostor, invalid_reference for missing netlist files, invalid_command when no setup form is given.

(execute) AdapterError: invalid_reference for a missing workdir, invalid_command for an ambiguous library without cell, runner_unavailable when netgen produces no report, plus the preflight codes (execute re-checks first).

(parse) AdapterError: runner_unavailable when the output has no LVS verdict.

Caution: Netgen exits 0 on match and mismatch alike — the verdict always comes from parsed output, never the exit code. PATH presence is not enough: same-named impostor binaries are rejected by banner probe.

run_optical.text:
run_optical via SAX: frequency-domain photonic circuit sim.

#### Tool `sax`

run_optical via SAX: frequency-domain photonic circuit sim.

Serves the run_optical operation with deck.tool `sax` (the only
tool). Stages the sim driver plus a job JSON, runs it under a
timeout, and parses the JSON envelope: spectra plus per-target
transmission measurements against min_db/max_db bounds.

Arguments:

- `sources` (required): Exactly one circuit spec YAML path.
- `timeout_s`: Sim budget in seconds (default 120).
- `tool_dir`: Directory holding the sim python; the engine interpreter otherwise.
- `deck`: Optional mapping; deck.tool must be sax here.
- `workdir`: Run directory (default ".").
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read; defaults to the command's own expected_revision entry.
- `request`: Explicit run knobs (xschem live-var equivalents), frozen into the run snapshot. Unknown fields are rejected.

Returns:

{total, violations[], measurements[], spectra[], sax_version} with dB values and margins.

Raises:

(preflight) AdapterError: unsupported_operation for another operation, invalid_command for a bad timeout or circuit spec, invalid_reference unless exactly one readable spec source is given, missing_dependency for an unresolvable sim python.

(execute) AdapterError: invalid_reference for a missing workdir, runner_unavailable on a sim timeout, plus the preflight codes (execute re-checks first).

(parse) AdapterError: missing_dependency when the sim python has no sax, runner_unavailable when the driver printed no JSON envelope, no result, or misses a target pair.

Caution: Missed target bounds are FAIL and a malformed circuit synthesizes an error violation with file/line — the verdict always comes from parsed output, never the exit code.

run_spice.text:
run_spice via ngspice: corner sims with measured bounds.

Tools: `ngspice` (default) — `deck.tool` selects; a missing tool falls back to the default, an unknown tool fails `unsupported_operation` before anything runs.

Handlers: `rocket_engine.adapters.ngspice.NgspiceAdapter`.

#### Tool `ngspice`

run_spice via ngspice: corner sims with measured bounds.

Serves the run_spice operation with deck.tool `ngspice` (the
only tool). Stages a corner deck (preamble + netlist bodies +
generated .control), runs it in batch, and parses meas_* values
against min/max bounds; bound misses are FAIL, valueless sims
synthesize sim_fail violations.

Arguments:

- `sources` (required): Netlist source paths staged as bodies.
- `measurements` (required): [{name, expr, unit?, min?, max?}] with numeric min and/or max each.
- `analyses`: .control analysis lines (default op).
- `options`: .option lines (default [wnflag=1]).
- `params`: .param name/value mapping.
- `corner`: Model corner (default tt).
- `temp_c`: Temperature in C (default 27).
- `title`: Deck title line.
- `pdk`: {id, revision, model_rel?, engine_root?} pin for PDK models via the store; omitted sims model-free.
- `timeout_s`: Sim budget in seconds (default 120).
- `tool_dir`: Directory holding ngspice; PATH otherwise.
- `deck`: Optional mapping; deck.tool must be ngspice here.
- `workdir`: Run directory (default ".").
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read; defaults to the command's own expected_revision entry.
- `request`: Explicit run knobs (xschem live-var equivalents), frozen into the run snapshot. Unknown fields are rejected.

Returns:

{total, violations[], measurements[]} with value, unit, target, margin, and status per measurement.

Raises:

(preflight) AdapterError: unsupported_operation for another operation, invalid_command for bad inputs (timeout, measurements, analyses, options, params, corner, temp_c, title), invalid_reference for missing sources, store codes (unknown_pdk, pdk_drift, ...) for a bad PDK pin, missing_dependency for an unresolvable ngspice.

(execute) AdapterError: invalid_reference for a missing workdir or unreadable netlist, runner_unavailable on a sim timeout, plus the preflight codes (execute re-checks first).

(parse) AdapterError: runner_unavailable when ngspice produced no output at all.

Caution: Verdicts always come from parsed output, never the exit code — and PDK models resolve through the store, so a wrong revision or tampered model fails loudly instead of simming against substitutes.

save_layer_preset.summary: Save a user layer preset against one PDK's stackup.
save_layer_preset.text:
Save a user layer preset against one PDK's stackup.

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.layer_preset_save`.

Missing layer names default to hidden; apply() resolves
the full map.

Arguments:

- `pdk_id` (required): Canonical display id (either spelling resolves).
- `name` (required): Preset name (built-in names are reserved).
- `layers` (required): Sparse {layer name: visible} map.
- `render_layers`: {toggle: bool} viewer aids; the default set when omitted.
- `flip`: View-from-bottom flag.
- `active`: Active layer name, or None.
- `overwrite`: Replace an existing user preset of the same name instead of conflicting.
- `revision`: Revision pin; the newest registered revision when omitted.
- `engine_root`: Explicit store root; resolved when omitted.

Returns:

Stored preset record (builtin False).

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_command for a missing pdk_id. PdkError: unknown_pdk for a missing store/id/revision. LayerServingError: unknown_stackup for an unmapped PDK, invalid_preset for a bad name/shape, preset_conflict for a built-in name or an existing preset without overwrite.

Caution: View state, not project state: presets live in Engine memory (no revision advance, no ledger event) and are lost on restart until a durable store lands.

serve_asset.summary: Serve one PDK file's bytes verbatim with hash identity.
serve_asset.text:
Serve one PDK file's bytes verbatim with hash identity.

Handler: `rocket_engine.composition.Engine.serve_asset`.

No conversion, no rendering: the sha256 is computed over
the raw bytes, base64 is transport encoding only.

Arguments:

- `pdk_id`: PDK id (either display spelling resolves).
- `revision`: PDK revision pin.
- `path`: Store-relative file path.
- `engine_root`: Explicit store root; ROCKETEDA_HOME resolution when omitted.

Returns:

Mapping with asset_version, pdk_id, display_id, revision, canonical path, size, sha256, and the verbatim bytes base64-encoded.

Raises:

ProjectError: invalid_command when pdk id, revision, or path is missing; invalid_reference for an unknown PDK, a missing file, or an escaping path.

Caution: No size cap — bulk reads belong to list_assets plus selective serve_asset calls, never a blind loop.

set_component.summary: Upsert one component payload (create or overwrite).
set_component.text:
Upsert one component payload (create or overwrite).

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.set_component`.

Persists through the entity record at entities/<entity>.json
with the same admission machinery as write_doc, and appends
component_changed with entity, component, and revision.

A resubmitted envelope returns its stored response without
advancing.

Arguments:

- `entity` (required): Entity id holding the component.
- `component` (required): Component name to write.
- `data` (required): JSON payload to store.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with entity, component, canonical address, storage path, revision transition, new head, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the component_changed event, cursor, and request id.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; invalid_entity, invalid_component, or invalid_data for malformed parts; unknown_entity for a missing entity; backfill_readonly for a backfilled id; invalid_document for a corrupt entity record; revision_conflict for a stale head; invalid_ledger when the durable write fails.

Caution: Every accepted write advances the revision — a second writer at the old head fails instead of merging.

split_wire.summary: Split one wire at an interior point: gate, run, log.
split_wire.text:
Split one wire at an interior point: gate, run, log.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.split_wire`.

The junction dot, the head rewrite, and the new tail wire
land in one revision under one event.

Arguments:

- `wire_id` (required): Wire entity to split.
- `at` (required): Integer [x, y] point on the polyline interior.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with the split receipt (wire, junction, new_wire), revision transition, new head, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the appended event, cursor, and request id.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; revision_conflict for a stale head; unknown_wire for a missing wire; invalid_split for a point off the interior or a multi-polyline wire; unsupported_operation without the ENGINE-ECS entity store.

write_doc.summary: Write one document: gate, store, advance, log.
write_doc.text:
Write one document: gate, store, advance, log.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.write_doc`.

A resubmitted envelope returns its stored response without
advancing; a new envelope gates its expected_revision, and
only an accepted write advances the revision and appends
the doc_written event.

Arguments:

- `path` (required): Document path to create or overwrite.
- `content` (required): UTF-8 text to store (1 MB limit).
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with path, revision transition, new head, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the appended event, cursor, and request id.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; invalid_path or path_escape for a bad path; invalid_command for non-text or oversize content or a directory path; revision_conflict for a stale head; invalid_ledger when the durable write fails.

Caution: Every accepted write advances the revision — a second writer at the old head fails instead of merging.

write_settings.summary: Write one settings kind: validate, gate, merge, log.
write_settings.text:
Write one settings kind: validate, gate, merge, log.

Handler: `rocket_engine.project.service.ProjectService.write_settings`.

Full replacement of the kind's truth, persisted as the
settings/<kind>.yaml document through the same admission
machinery as write_doc (idempotent request ids, revision
gate, one new revision, one event, atomic persist, rewind
snapshots). The write merges onto the stored bytes so
unknown keys survive; data maps replace wholesale, so
text.vars deletes propagate. Unchanged bytes skip the
write: no new revision, no event.

A resubmitted envelope returns its stored response without
advancing.

Arguments:

- `kind` (required): Settings kind (chip.manifest, design.rules, net.classes, text.vars, lib.tables).
- `settings` (required): Complete settings mapping at the head version.
- `expected_revision`: Revision the writer read.

Returns:

Mutation mapping with path, revision transition, new head, actor, diff summary, rewind handle, the appended event, cursor, request id, written flag, and settings version.

Raises:

ProjectError: request_conflict for a reused id with new text; invalid_command for an unknown kind or settings that break the kind schema; revision_conflict for a stale head; future_format when the stored file is newer than the head; invalid_document for stored settings that do not parse; invalid_ledger when the durable write fails.

Caution: Every accepted write advances the revision — a second writer at the old head fails instead of merging — and text.vars writes delete vars the new map omits.
